name: us032-no-off-switch
description: 032 C4.12/C7.5: a committed config.yml carrying plausible disabling keys ("pin_enforcement: false", "verify_destination: false") alongside a destination this checkout is not bound to. No value readable from a committed file may switch the gate off (FR-015). The run fails closed with an empty mock call log, byte-identically across ports. SPEC_KIT_JIRA_BASE_URL is blanked so the destination is file-supplied and the gate actually applies.
